# My Team Is Growing, How Do I Structure Who Gets Access to What?

## What Changed

Your project started with one or two people. Now developers, operators, analysts, and applications all need access to Azure Cosmos DB. Giving everyone the same permissions might feel efficient, but it makes every identity more powerful than its job requires. As your team grows, organize access around jobs, not people.
